title: Catalan-Style Grilled Octopus
description: A traditional Spanish-inspired dish from the region of Catalonia, featuring tender grilled octopus with a tangy and smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: Octopus (pulpo)
ingredients.amount: 1 large, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Energizing Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Catalan-Style Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A blend of paprika, garlic, and oregano

ingredients.name: Gallega Sea Salt
ingredients.notes: A mild, flaky sea salt from the Galicia region

instructions: Season the octopus with Catalan-Style Spice Blend and Gallega Sea Salt.
Brush the grill grates with Energizing Olive Oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred and cooked through.
Transfer the octopus to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
